entities.summary: Abu ’l-Maḥāsin Ṣafī al-Dīn Abd al-Aziz ibn Saraya al-Ḥillī al-Ṭāyyʾī al-Sinbisī, more commonly known as Ṣafī al-Dīn al-Ḥillī or Ṣafiddīn al-Ḥilli, was a 14th-century Arab warrior poet.
